text.en: Modal damping of steady multistage RK A 16-component periodic linear field measures pseudo-time residual damping with stable, neutral and expanding controls. This is distinct from fourth-order accuracy for nonlinear physical-time problems. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-steady-rk-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Real-space mode damping with steady multistage RK Apply four steady residual stages on a periodic grid, separating damping, neutrality and amplification of discrete modes. The retained first run missed the original absolute residual goal in the expanding control. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries A fixed dimensionless sixteen-node periodic linear residual; pseudo-time is an iteration parameter. Editorial clarification Limited to a fixed linear example; no JST compressible flux, nonlinear fourth-order RK or all-start convergence claim. Verification of this study does not mean that all original numerical targets were met. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Use the same base state in every stage and retain complete fields, stage residuals and evaluation counts. Yj=un−alphaj∗dtau∗(A∗Y(j−1)−b) P(z)=1+z+z2/2+z3/6+z4/24;lambda4=9+2i,lambda8=17 References and measured quantities Retain all 41 original numerical targets and their actual decisions. Only the expanding-control absolute residual goal is a separate study outcome; the other 40 requirements and faithful recomputation from saved arrays remain mandatory. Verification limits and failures Limited to a fixed linear example; no JST compressible flux, nonlinear fourth-order RK or all-start convergence claim. Verification of this study does not mean that all original numerical targets were met. Stored measurements and decisions Original numerical targets: 40/41 met Outcomes retain unmet targets under the original inputs and criteria. Passing the separate reproduction/reporting checks does not mean that every original accuracy goal was met.
